name: Hinode
tagline: Tokyo in 14 minutes and Toranomon in 14 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥140,000 to ¥150,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, served by Yurikamome. Journey times to the main business districts are 21 minutes to Otemachi, 29 minutes to Shinjuku, 27 minutes to Shibuya and 18 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥140,000 to ¥150,000. The station stands 2.7 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 4.6 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 2.7 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 1.3 m to 5.9 m, a difference of 4.6 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. For storm surge, 3 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 2 clinics and 3 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 芝公園かみやまクリニック, about 685 m away and 愛育病院, about 687 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Yurikamome. Only one line runs here, so when it stops you will be walking to a station on another line. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 32.

rentRange.note: One room ¥140,000 to ¥150,000, 1K ¥130,000 to ¥140,000, 1LDK ¥240,000 to ¥250,000 and 2LDK ¥350,000 to ¥360,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Hinode, but Takeshiba is ahead on how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: 613 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Hinode. One-room rents run about ¥30,000 higher.

neighbours.lead: Hamamatsucho is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is, but Hinode is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: 729 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi 9 minutes sooner than Hinode.

noiseSources: 新橋日の出ふ頭線 (a main road) runs 4 m away. Morning and evening, the cars are audible indoors
海岸通り (4 lanes each way) runs 45 m away. Traffic on it never stops

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 6 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 11 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make: 新橋日の出ふ頭線 runs 4 m away.
